The planned command does not exercise the three documents, the surface set, cross-surface consistency or the ban on copied machinery (req-pressure:18). Those need separate observation or assessment.

It is still undecided whether 'artifact summaries' or the full file contents are the evidence source (req-pressure:03). I derived from the full contents at the declared digests.

The comment at the top of each test names its predecessors but leaves out package.json. The link to package.json is only a consistency check (ES modules, built-ins only), and changing the comment alone would just manufacture provenance and change the component-test predecessor digest, so I left it.

Minor: the conformance document counts package.json and src/hello.mjs as one 'source' surface, while the design lists them separately. It is a difference in granularity, not a conflict, and the design does not state the mapping outright.

Two points remain unassessed: whether the ABG ownership sentence in the conformance document uses current terms (req-pressure:12), and what executeFromPlan: false means (req-pressure:15). The mapping of observed results to executionStatus, planSatisfied, pass count and the stdout digest is still undecided (req-pressure:04).
